PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

RCA-driven issue resolution across Healthcare, Cyber Security, FinTech and Enterprise Product organizations — including 
hands-on experience supporting HealthEdge Technologies' US Healthcare Payer platform. Owns production stability and

coordinating Development, QA, Infrastructure and Business teams through permanent fixes. Works directly with US-based 
clients and stakeholders during critical incidents and reports directly to the Technical Director on vulnerability remediation 
and risk posture. Builds Shell/Bash automation to improve support efficiency and reduce time-to-resolution, and translates 
operational outcomes into executive-ready reporting.
